The pair with the highest BoolQ retention is **Qwen3 14B→32B, at 101.9%** (Table 18, p. 21).

The other pairs' BoolQ retention, from the same table (p. 21):

- Qwen3 8B→32B: 99.9%
- Llama 3.1 8B→70B: 96.2%
- Ministral 3 3B→8B: 95.1%
- Ministral 3 3B→14B: 57.4%
- Ministral 3 8B→14B: 44.4%

PIQA, BoolQ and ARC-Easy were never used to select k. For each pair, the fit and k were left unchanged, so these numbers measure the reported configuration out of sample (p. 21). Retention is measured against the target's standalone accuracy on the same benchmark, which is why a value above 100% is possible (Table 18, p. 21).
